title: ctenitis hypolepioides
intro: Ctenitis hypolepioides, commonly known as the Chinese ladder fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis hypolepioides include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as arthritis and hypertension. The bioactive constituents of Ctenitis hypolepioides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
